1.sahih_international: By the sun and its brightness
1.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,
1.yusuf_ali: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
1.shakir: I swear by the sun and its brilliance,
1.muhammad_sarwar: By the sun and its noon-time brightness,
1.mohsin_khan: And by the sun and its brightness;
1.arberry: By the sun and his morning brightness

2.sahih_international: And [by] the moon when it follows it
2.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,
2.yusuf_ali: By the Moon as she follows him;
2.shakir: And the moon when it follows the sun,
2.muhammad_sarwar: by the moon when it follows the sun,
2.mohsin_khan: And by the moon as it follows it (the sun);
2.arberry: and by the moon when she follows him,

3.sahih_international: And [by] the day when it displays it
3.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,
3.yusuf_ali: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
3.shakir: And the day when it shows it,
3.muhammad_sarwar: by the day when it brightens the earth,
3.mohsin_khan: And by the day as it shows up (the sun's) brightness;
3.arberry: and by the day when it displays him

4.sahih_international: And [by] the night when it covers it
4.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
4.yusuf_ali: By the Night as it conceals it;
4.shakir: And the night when it draws a veil over it,
4.muhammad_sarwar: by the night when it covers the earth with darkness,
4.mohsin_khan: And by the night as it conceals it (the sun);
4.arberry: and by the night when it enshrouds him!

5.sahih_international: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
5.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
5.yusuf_ali: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
5.shakir: And the heaven and Him Who made it,
5.muhammad_sarwar: by the heavens and that (Power) which established them,
5.mohsin_khan: And by the heaven and Him Who built it;
5.arberry: By the heaven and That which built it

6.sahih_international: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
6.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
6.yusuf_ali: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
6.shakir: And the earth and Him Who extended it,
6.muhammad_sarwar: by the earth and that (Power) which spread it out
6.mohsin_khan: And by the earth and Him Who spread it,
6.arberry: and by the earth and That which extended it!

7.sahih_international: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
7.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
7.yusuf_ali: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
7.shakir: And the soul and Him Who made it perfect,
7.muhammad_sarwar: and by the soul and that (Power) which designed it
7.mohsin_khan: And by Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul, etc.), and Him Who perfected him in proportion;
7.arberry: By the soul, and That which shaped it

8.sahih_international: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
8.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
8.yusuf_ali: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
8.shakir: Then He inspired it to understand what is right and wrong for it;
8.muhammad_sarwar: and inspired it with knowledge of evil and piety,
8.mohsin_khan: Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him;
8.arberry: and inspired it to lewdness and godfearing!

9.sahih_international: He has succeeded who purifies it,
9.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
9.yusuf_ali: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
9.shakir: He will indeed be successful who purifies it,
9.muhammad_sarwar: those who purify their souls will certainly have everlasting happiness
9.mohsin_khan: Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allah ordered, by following the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).
9.arberry: Prosperous is he who purifies it,

10.sahih_international: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
10.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
10.yusuf_ali: And he fails that corrupts it!
10.shakir: And he will indeed fail who corrupts it.
10.muhammad_sarwar: and those who corrupt their souls will certainly be deprived (of happiness).
10.mohsin_khan: And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allah has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism or by following polytheism, etc. or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds).
10.arberry: and failed has he who seduces it.

11.sahih_international: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
11.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
11.yusuf_ali: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
11.shakir: Samood gave the lie (to the truth) in their inordinacy,
11.muhammad_sarwar: The people of Thamud rejected (the truth) as a result of their rebelliousness
11.mohsin_khan: Thamud (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin).
11.arberry: Thamood cried lies in their insolence

12.sahih_international: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
12.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
12.yusuf_ali: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
12.shakir: When the most unfortunate of them broke forth with
12.muhammad_sarwar: when the most corrupt of them incited them (to commit evil).
12.mohsin_khan: When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).
12.arberry: when the most wretched of them uprose,

13.sahih_international: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
13.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
13.yusuf_ali: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
13.shakir: So Allah's apostle said to them (Leave alone) Allah's she-camel, and (give) her (to) drink.
13.muhammad_sarwar: The Messenger of God told them, "This is a she-camel, belonging to God. Do not deprive her of her share of water".
13.mohsin_khan: But the Messenger of Allah [Salih (Saleh)] said to them: "Be cautious! Fear the evil end. That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!"
13.arberry: then the Messenger of God said to them, 'The She-camel of God; let her drink!'

14.sahih_international: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
14.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
14.yusuf_ali: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
14.shakir: But they called him a liar and slaughtered her, therefore their Lord crushed them for their sin and levelled them (with the ground).
14.muhammad_sarwar: However, they rejected him and slew her. So their Lord completely destroyed them and their city for their sins.
14.mohsin_khan: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)!
14.arberry: But they cried him lies, and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled them:

15.sahih_international: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
15.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
15.yusuf_ali: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
15.shakir: And He fears not its consequence.
15.muhammad_sarwar: God is not afraid of the result of what He had decreed.
15.mohsin_khan: And He (Allah) feared not the consequences thereof.
15.arberry: and He fears not the issue thereof.
